description: Expected verdicts for the MiSTer Apple IIgs custom diagnostics booted under POMIIGS (tools/mister_diags.py). `expect` = pass | xfail; every xfail names the emulator gap it tracks. An unexpected PASS is reported so the entry can be promoted.

tests.note: 26/26 since CYAREG shadow-all ($C036 b4), the NEWVIDEO bank latch, the floating bus and the LC physical layout are modelled (fpi_shadowall_test pins the same cases)
Y = failure count; the program ends with RTS from a SYSTEM launcher (no return address) so the monitor's register dump is its exit report. A failure table ('0201 0201') is printed on row 0 instead

corpus dispute: the replica assumes the 8530 register pointer survives a read ('pointer stays at 12 after read') and writes the next pattern without re-selecting; the Z8530 resets the pointer to 0 after any access to a register other than WR0, and the ROM's own test 06 ($FF:6934) re-selects before every read — that real sequence passes (rom0[13]_selftest_01_08). The BRK afterwards is the RTS out of the SYSTEM launcher

not IIgs hardware: the test relies on the MiSTer core wiring channel A's TxD to channel B's RxD and vice versa (iigs.sv); a stock IIgs has two independent ports. POMIIGS models per-channel loopback only (scc_test)

corpus dispute: the test polls $C027 bit 7 for command completion, but that bit is mouse-data-only per the Apple IIgs Hardware Reference and the current MiSTer adb.v (their older RTL folded pending command data into it); a data-less bus command leaves b5 clear too. POMIIGS answers the $80 status at $C026 as the test expects, so it fails only on the poll
needs the ADB µC firmware (341-0632) — hangs after 'T' without it
unit $60 (5.25" WOZ via the IWM bit-cell path), 6/6

POMIIGS-derived variant (tools/build_floppy35_variant.sh): the upstream test only ever probes unit $60; this one also runs unit $50 — an 800K .2mg through the genuine slot-5 ROM firmware and the Sony LLE, read/write/verify 6/6 — 12/12 with both media (the Sony model takes sector images, not WOZ bit streams)

POMIIGS-authored (tests/cycle_accuracy/diags/SONY_FORMAT.S, tools/build_pom_diags.sh): SmartPort STATUS/FORMAT/WRITE/READ + verify on an unformatted 800K .2mg through the genuine slot-5 ROM firmware and the Sony LLE — whole-track format sessions and the ROM's tach check included

same diagnostic on a WOZ2: the ROM formats through Sony35's WOZ path (bit stream → nibbles, dirty tracks re-encoded with 10-bit syncs, fresh WOZ2 written) and CiderPress2 — an independent decoder — must read every block of the result
3.5" read/write/verify on a cp2-made ProDOS WOZ2 through the Sony WOZ path (the guest verifies each write)
hour and minute are printed as hex bytes
RAM test overwrites the RAM launcher (inherent to launching from $2000); sequential selftest_trace covers it
RAM address test overwrites the RAM launcher; sequential selftest_trace covers it
the launcher only checks the carry; the ROM's checksum of the ADB µC firmware is gated separately (rom03_selftest_9)

the shadow test fills the text page with $DA ('Z'); needs the ~200 µs ADB response latency, otherwise the ROM IRQ manager steals the µC version byte in the PLP…SEI gap of $FF:6F9A/$6FBF when ProDOS has enabled the DATAREG interrupt
interrupt test: passes only when the periodic Mega II/VGC interrupts run (diag_trace calls frameTick like the emulator loop)
the Ensoniq test needs ~40 s of emulated time
